title: Warm Kenyan Flatbread
description: A simple and delicious flatbread from Kenya, perfect for serving with your favorite stews or as a side dish.

ingredients.name: Flatbread dough enhancer
ingredients.notes: Optional, but recommended for a lighter texture

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine warm water and 1 teaspoon of salt. Let it sit for 5 minutes.
Add 2 cups of Kenyan flour to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 4-6 equal pieces, depending on how large you want your flatbreads to be.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
Heat a non-stick pan or griddle over medium heat. Brush the pan with olive oil.
Cook the flatbread for 1-2 minutes on each side, until it's lightly browned and puffed up.
Repeat with the remaining dough pieces.
Serve the flatbread warm, either on its own or with your favorite stews or toppings.
